title: Per-user data isolation requirement
description: How every read and write of user-owned rows is scoped to the signed-in user, and how another user's rows answer (ADR-0041).

owner-column.description: The non-null owner column on every user-owned table and what it references.

identity-key.description: What identifies a user row and how it is resolved at sign-in.

scoping-mechanism.description: The mechanism that applies the owner predicate to every query and write.

fail-closed.description: What a context without a signed-in user sees.

legacy-owner.description: Who owns rows created before ownership existed and how that owner is claimed.

session-claim.description: How the user id travels with the session and what happens to sessions without it.

cross-user-response.description: What the API answers for another user's row.

client-supplied-user.description: Whether any endpoint accepts a user identifier from the client. Must be false.

tests.description: The tests that assert the isolation.
